naboer

naboer constructs dependence-aware cross-validation designs for ecological and environmental data. It distinguishes observations assessed by a fold from observations omitted during fitting, including dependence buffers. Export these designs to mgcv for NCV/QNCV smoothness selection, or to rsample for explicit resampling workflows.

This is a development version. tools/RELEASE.md records the validation required before 0.1.0.

Temporal neighbourhoods 

library("naboer")

observations <- tibble::tibble(
  site = rep(c("north", "south"), each = 30),
  time = rep(1:30, 2),
  response = sin(time / 5) + rep(c(0, 0.5), each = 30)
)

folds <- observations |>
  neighbourhoods(
    key = site, index = time, within = "key",
    temporal = temporal_window(time_span(2, "seconds"))
  )
tibble::as_tibble(folds, folds = 1:3, membership = TRUE)
nei <- as_nei(folds)

if (requireNamespace("mgcv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fit <- mgcv::gam(
    response ~ s(time, k = 8) + site,
    data = fold_data(folds), method = "NCV", nei = nei,
    na.action = stats::na.fail
  )
}

Numeric time indices are seconds. For dates, use Date/POSIXct with elapsed or calendar spans. time_span(1, "months", "calendar") follows the calendar; time_span(3, "observations") counts rows within an ordered series. Tsibble keys/index and cubble metadata are inferred automatically.

Space and time together 

if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("units", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stations <- sf::st_as_sf(
    tibble::tibble(site = c("a", "b", "c"), x = c(0, 1000, 5000), y = 0),
    coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 32632
  )
  space <- neighbourhoods(
    stations, spatial = spatial_window(units::set_units(2, "km"))
  )
}

Supply both window arguments and explicitly choose combine = "intersection" or "union" for spatiotemporal neighbourhoods. Keys identify stations or series; .by defines independent domains. Multiple temporal series require within = "key" or within = "domain". Neither keys nor group_by() silently declare independence.

Choose a prediction task

Task Constructors
Predict observations beyond local dependence neighbourhoods(), buffer_folds()
Predict new places or periods spatial_folds(), temporal_folds(), spatiotemporal_folds()
Forecast using only information available at an origin forecast_folds()
Predict new groups, environments or taxa group_folds(), environmental_folds(), phylogenetic_folds()
Supply a custom or external design custom_folds(), from_rset()

Inspect with summary(), tibble::as_tibble() and ggplot2::autoplot(). Large memberships remain compressed until requested. Export estimates packed size and defaults to a 1 GiB limit, controlled by max_bytes or naboer.max_bytes. Million-observation sparse designs are benchmarked; wide windows can still require enormous output.

Prepare complete modelling data before constructing folds. Rebuild the design after changing observations or their order. A valid design specifies a prediction task; it does not establish NCV approximation accuracy or automatically select an appropriate dependence radius.

R >= 4.4 is required. Spatial, temporal-class, phylogenetic, plotting and rsample integrations use optional dependencies. See the package site for worked workflows and the statistical contract.
